description_en: Retrieves the drivers associated with multiple sub-devices in a batch
description_zh: 批量获取子设备关联的驱动
kebab_example: aliyun iot batch-get-edge-instance-device-driver --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --instance-id 6GaTtvTj7vJhiS000000 --iot-ids example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchGetEdgeInstanceDeviceDriver

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the edge instance. In the Link IoT Edge console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the target edge instance name on the Edge Instances page to obtain the ID.

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh:
边缘实例的ID。在边缘计算控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的边缘实例页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html接口获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of sub-device IDs. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69905.html operation to query device IDs.

You can specify up to 20 device IDs in a single call
parameters.help_zh:
子设备ID列表。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69905.html接口查询设备ID。

单次调用最多可填写20个设备ID
parameters.name: iot_ids
